name: galeno-video
description: Videos del sitio de Galeno, hechos con Remotion a partir de capturas reales de la app.

scripts.render:hero: remotion render src/index.ts Hero-es out/hero-es.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Hero-en out/hero-en.mp4
scripts.render:whatsapp: remotion render src/index.ts WhatsApp-es out/whatsapp-es.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts WhatsApp-en out/whatsapp-en.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:hero && npm run render:whatsapp
